sloka: साय आह्ने विचरन् राम दर्शयिष्यति लक्ष्मणः ।अपाम् लोभात उपावृत्तान् वृषभान् इव नर्दतः ॥३-७३-१९॥
transliteration: sāya āhne vicaran rāma darśayiṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ ।apām lobhāta upāvṛttān vṛṣabhān iva nardataḥ ॥3-73-19॥

translations.english: O best of men you will see huge boars of delightful appearance that roar like bulls resting in mountain caves, roaming in the forest and coming to Pampa for its water.
